ad_copy.name: Ad1 Fatigue Refresh - Tiny-Space Phone
ad_copy.concept: For the 31-year-old scrolling on the sofa after dinner thinking the workout window has closed, show the tiny-space, no-gear 10-minute workout already on her phone right beside her.
ad_copy.headline: Ten minutes. Just your floor.
ad_copy.primary_text: Your 10-minute workout lives on your phone. No gear, just a little floor space. Start with a 7-day free trial.

claims.text: Workouts need no equipment and fit a small floor space at home
